app-templates.message:
feat(explainer): neutral practice text, worked tasks off with JavaScript, formulas in quiz texts

## Intent

The chemistry explainer hit three limits of the template that an app cannot change. The practice sentence said "immer neuen Zahlen" where elements or substances vary. Three worked tasks appeared after each solved task, although with JavaScript a learner gets as many new tasks as they like. Formulas in quiz texts showed as raw characters.

## Key changes

- The sentence above the live task is the exercise's optional `practice`, else the neutral "Übe selbst, mit immer neuen Aufgaben:".
- The worked tasks show only without JavaScript, unless the exercise sets `workedTasks: always`.
- In the texts of quiz-type exercises `$…$` is a formula, rendered as MathML at build and checked like every formula.
- Schema, building blocks and runtime view describe the new fields; tests cover the formulas.

## Dependencies and side effects

- Closes lernapps/app-templates#45.
